description: This file defines a JavaScript module that provides a function to fetch session duration histogram data from a backend API. It includes a helper function for building query strings and exports an asynchronous function 'getDurationHistogram' that constructs API requests with various parameters, handles responses, and provides fallback/error handling.

methods.name: buildQueryString
methods.description: Helper function to build URL query strings from parameters object.

methods.name: getDurationHistogram
methods.description: Fetches session duration histogram data from the backend API, with support for various filtering parameters and error handling.
